name: Hornero Battery
description: Battery 2.0: contextual bar indicator over the PluginKit Power facade, hidden by default when no battery is reported, with a power-detail popover and dashboard card. Real no-battery/unknown states only.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Battery & Uptime 2.0 (#31): no permanent 'No battery' bar item by default (showWhenNoBattery opt-in restores it), host-owned popover and dashboard card with charge/state/power-source detail from PluginKit Power only, low-battery chip, typed settings, host-context layout and Spanish catalog.
Bar widget showing battery percentage and charging state from PluginKit Power; showed 'No battery' on machines without a battery.

showWhenNoBattery.description: Keep a permanent 'No battery' bar item when Power reports no battery (the 1.x behaviour). Off, the 2.0 default, takes no bar space on desktops.

showPercentage.description: Show the battery percentage in the bar indicator (the 1.x behaviour).

showStateText.description: Append the Power state (charging, fully-charged, discharging, pending-charge) when known (the 1.x behaviour).

lowBatteryPercent.description: Charge percent at or below which, while on battery, a low-battery chip is shown. Adds a chip only; 1.x had no threshold.
